sentences.l2: 小两口在城市工作多年，最近开始认真考虑和父母同住，或者至少住得近一些。
sentences.l1: The young couple have worked in the city for many years, and recently began seriously considering living with their parents, or at least living nearby.

sentences.l2: 父母年纪渐长，若同住，日常照顾会更方便，也能减轻家务和育儿压力；可他们担心婆媳关系变得复杂，也害怕生活习惯不同引发摩擦。
sentences.l1: With their parents growing older, living together would make daily care more convenient and could also ease the pressure of housework and child-rearing; but they worry that the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law relationship would become complicated, and also fear that differing living habits would cause friction.

sentences.l2: 妻子习惯早起安静地准备早餐，母亲则喜欢边看电视边聊天；丈夫希望周末能独自休息，不愿总被安排家庭活动。
sentences.l1: The wife is used to getting up early and quietly preparing breakfast, while the mother likes to chat while watching television; the husband hopes to rest alone on weekends and does not want to be always arranged into family activities.

sentences.l2: 经过反复商量，他们意识到独立并不意味着疏远，而是要在亲情与边界之间找到平衡。
sentences.l1: After repeated discussion, they realised that independence does not mean distance, but that a balance must be found between family affection and boundaries.

sentences.l2: 最终，他们在同一小区租下两套房子，既能在需要时互相照应，又能保留各自的生活节奏。
sentences.l1: In the end, they rented two apartments in the same residential compound, so that they can look after each other when needed and also keep their own rhythms of life.
